name: which
summary: Shows which program will run for a command.
description: Looks for the command in the PATH directories, in order, and prints the path of the first executable found: that is the one the shell will run. Useful when several versions are installed. which does not see aliases or shell builtins; type does.

options.description: Prints every matching executable in the PATH, not just the first one.

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: Name(s) of the command(s) to locate.

examples.explanation: Path of the python3 that is used.
Every version of node found in the PATH.

examples.command: which docker || echo "docker is not installed"
examples.explanation: which fails if the command cannot be found: handy in a script.
